sentence: This project builds tools that measure proteins carrying genetic variants to tell which variants cause disease, including protein misfolding in amyloidosis.
This project builds an optical brain imaging device and analysis methods to map how the brain develops in children, including autism spectrum disorder.
This project studies how cellular stress responses affect muscle health in Drosophila during aging, exercise training and metabolic disorders after high calorie diets.
This project builds a system that uses electrical impedance tomography to check where an endotracheal tube sits in infants and to image the lungs.
This project designs and builds electronic systems and mechanical instruments that vision research projects need, and repairs equipment.
This project tests whether human cell-derived nanovesicles can deliver genes without viruses in a model of myotonic dystrophy type 1.
This project studies how genes and other molecular data across different populations relate to Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
This project examines neuroimmune activity in the nucleus accumbens, a brain region, to learn how neurons and non-neuronal brain cells promote excessive alcohol consumption.
This project studies how reactive astrocytes change their metabolism and how that affects brain repair after stroke, using cell and mouse models.
This project uses Ecological Momentary Assessment to study cannabis use and Ecological Momentary Intervention to prevent cannabis use disorder in youth in the legal system.
This project improves the sensitivity and spectral resolution of a tool used to study protein structure, metabolic flux, enzyme mechanisms and cell wall structure.
This project continues a program on cancer biology that links work in the laboratory to the care of patients with cancer.
This project uses bedside cardiac ultrasound molecular imaging of inflammation to detect acute coronary syndromes or drug-induced myocarditis in patients receiving chemotherapy.
This project tests combined treatments for alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease in patients with advanced liver disease.
This project studies the hormonal, genetic and neuronal basis of sex differences in a vocal-motor nucleus of zebra finches.
This project studies how mutations in a cancer driver gene lead to tumor formation, growth and metastasis in breast cancer.
This project combines proteomics and genomics data from multiple cohorts to find biomarkers that detect hepatocellular carcinoma early and link chronic inflammation to it.
This project builds small-scale robots from catalytic nanoparticles that can kill, degrade and retrieve endodontic biofilms.
This project studies how a family of transcription factors controls sex-specific development of the gonads.
This project tries to find out how microglia and T cells interact in neuroinflammation and how that contributes to vision loss in glaucoma.
